Waxaad dhammaan Goobaha Gaarka ah ku shaandhayn kartaa adigoo qoraya magacyadooda iyo qiimayaashooda. Tusaale: Field1 == Value1. Ogow: Haddii goobaha ama qiimayaashu ay leeyihiin boosas, waa inaad ku wareejisaa hal calaamadood oo xigasho. Tusaale: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Si looga boodo hal calaamadood oo xakameyn ah (' \/), waxaad adeegsan kartaa \. Tusaale: Field1 == I\'m. Waxaad sidoo kale isku dari kartaa shuruudo badan. Tusaale: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Caadi ahaan dhammaan hawlwadeennada waxaa loo fasiraa bidix ilaa midig. Waxaad kala hormarinta ku beddeli kartaa adigoo dhigaya qawsas. Tusaale: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Waxaad sidoo kale goobaha qoraalka ku raadin kartaa regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

Hawlwadeennada waxaa lagu tilmaamaa iyadoo magaca hawlwadeenka iyo qiimaha lagu kala saarayo laba-dhibcood. Tusaale ahaan, qeexidda hawlwadeenka `list:Blocked` waxay raadinta ku koobaysaa kaararka ku jira liis la yiraahdo *Blocked*. Haddii qiimuhu leeyahay meelo bannaan ama xarfo gaar ah, waa in lagu dhex xiraa calaamadaha xigashada (tusaale `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).

Ku dhejinta `-` horta *<field>* waxay raadisaa maqnaanshaha qiime goobtaas ku jira (tusaale `has:-due` wuxuu raadiyaa kaararka aan lahayn taariikh kama dambays ah).

globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Hawlwadeenno badan ayaa la cayimi karaa.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Hawlwadeennada isku midka ah waxaa la isugu daraa *OR*. Kaararka waafaqa mid kasta oo xaaladaha ka mid ah ayaa la soo celinayaa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` wuxuu soo celinayaa kaararka ku jira liis kasta oo la yiraahdo *Blocked* ama *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Hawlwadeennada kala duwan waxaa la isugu daraa *AND*. Keliya kaararka waafaqa dhammaan hawlwadeennada kala duwan ayaa la soo celinayaa. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` wuxuu soo celiyaa keliya kaararka ku jira liiska *Available* ee leh sumad *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Maalmaha waxaa lagu cayimi karaa tiro dhan oo togan ama taban, ama iyadoo la adeegsanayo `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` ama `__predicate_year__` muddada hadda jirta.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Raadinta qoraalku ma kala soocdo far waaweyn iyo far yaryar.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Asal ahaan kaararka la kaydiyey lama raadiyo.

Tani waxay muujinaysaa in guuritaanku guulaystay iyo inta boos saxan ee faylasha ceeriin ee kaydkii hore ee MongoDB weli ku isticmaalaan grain-ka, waxayna kuu oggolaanaysaa inaad tirtirto faylashaas ceeriin si aad boos u bannayso.

disable-all-import-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, dhammaan awoodaha soo dejintu way dansan yihiin: ka soo dejinta sabuurad WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea iyo Forgejo, iyo sidoo kale koobiyeynta sabuurad. Xulashooyinka liiska soo dejinta waa qarsoon yihiin, adeeguhuna wuu diidayaa codsi kasta oo soo dejin ah. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
disable-all-export-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, dhammaan awoodaha dhoofintu way dansan yihiin: u dhoofinta sabuurad WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, ama NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, iyo dhoofinta hal lifaaq. Xulashooyinka liiska dhoofinta waa qarsoon yihiin, adeeguhuna wuu diidayaa codsi kasta oo dhoofin ah. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
disable-import-avatars-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, sawirrada astaanta (sawirrada bogga isticmaalaha) marna lama soo dejiyo. Tani waxay khusaysaa soo dejinta WeKan JSON, soo dejinta Trello iyo waafajinta sawirka astaanta ee bixiyeyaasha aqoonsiga dibadda marka la gelayo (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Magacyada iyo xogta kale weli waa la soo dejiyaa; sawirrada astaanta oo keliya ayaa la dhaafaa. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
disable-export-avatars-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, sawirrada astaanta (sawirrada bogga isticmaalaha) marna laguma daro marka sabuurad la dhoofinayo (dhoofinta WeKan JSON iyo CSV). Magacyada isticmaalaha iyo xogta kale weli waa la dhoofiyaa; sawirrada astaanta oo keliya ayaa laga reebaa. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
anonymize-import-users: Qari aqoonsiga isticmaalayaasha la soo dejiyo
anonymize-import-users-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, soo dejinta sabuurad WeKan JSON waxay magaca isticmaalaha, magaca buuxa iyo xarfaha hore ee isticmaale kasta oo la soo dejiyey ku beddeshaa meeleeyayaal tiro leh (user1, user2, ...), waxay tuurtaa sawirkooda astaanta, waxayna dib u qortaa xusitaanka @username (iyo goobaha requested-by / assigned-by) ee nuxurka kaarka iyo faallada la soo dejiyey. Wax aqoonsi isticmaale oo dhab ah oo sabuuradda isha ka yimid lama kaydiyo. Erayga "isticmaale" wuxuu raacaa luqadda qofka wax soo dejinaya. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
anonymize-export-users-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, dhoofinta sabuuraddu waxay magaca isticmaalaha, magaca buuxa iyo xarfaha hore ee isticmaale kasta oo la dhoofiyey ku beddeshaa meeleeyayaal tiro leh (user1, user2, ...), waxay tuurtaa sawirkooda astaanta, waxayna dib u qortaa xusitaanka @username (iyo goobaha requested-by / assigned-by) ee nuxurka kaarka iyo faallada. Faylka la dhoofiyey ma sido wax aqoonsi isticmaale oo dhab ah. Erayga "isticmaale" wuxuu raacaa luqadda qofka wax dhoofinaya. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
disable-activities-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, gelinnada quudinta hawsha marna lama diiwaangeliyo meelna laguma muujiyo (dhinaca sabuuradda iyo tabka hawsha kaarka). Wax taariikh ah oo cidda waxa samaysay lama hayo. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
disable-notifications-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, WeKan marna ma diro ogeysiisyada la-socodka (gudaha abka, iimayl ama adeegyo kale) hawl kasta. Hawlaha weli waa la diiwaangelin karaa (haddii aan sidoo kale kor laga damin); ogeysiisyada oo keliya ayaa la joojiyaa. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
disable-watch-description: Marka ay shidan tahay, awoodda la-socodku way dansan tahay—isticmaalayaashu iskuma qori karaan sabuuradaha, liisaska ama kaararka si ay ogeysiisyo u helaan, isku-day kasta oo lagu beddelayo heerka la-socodkana waa la diidayaa. Asal ahaan way dansan tahay.
backup-description: Samee nuqul-kayd Lifaaqyada, Sawirrada Astaanta iyo/ama Xogta (dhammaan ururinta qoraalka ku salaysan ee aan ahayn lifaaqyo ama sawirro astaan). Faylka .zip si toos ah ayaa loogu qulquliyaa kaydka la doortay—fayl ku-meelgaar ah ma jiro—sida backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, isagoo ka kooban YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars iyo /data. Kaydadka daruurta (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) waxay adeegsadaan aqoonsiyada lagu qaabeeyey tabyadooda kaydka.
backup-scope-description: Nidaamka oo dhan, ama hal Urur. Nuqul-kaydka Ururku wuxuu ka kooban yahay sabuuradihiisa iyo wax kasta oo saaran, oo ay ku jiraan lifaaqyada sabuuradahaas—laakiin kuma jiraan akoonnada isticmaalaha iyo dejimaha nidaamka, sababtoo ah kuwaas waxaa wadaaga Urur kasta. Soo-celinta nuqul-kaydka Ururku waxay wax ku qortaa keliya sabuuradaha Ururkaasi leeyahay.
backup-restore-select-first: Marka hore liiska ka dooro nuqul-kayd.
backup-restore-confirm: Ma la soo celiyaa nuqul-kaydka la doortay? Lifaaqyada/sawirrada astaanta waxaa lagu qoraa nidaamka faylasha, xogtana kaydka xogta iyadoo la raacayo habka la doortay.
gcs-key-filename-description: Ikhtiyaari: jidka faylka furaha JSON ee akoonka adeegga ee adeegaha.
gcs-credentials-description: Ikhtiyaari: ku dheji furaha JSON ee akoonka adeegga. Bannaan uga tag si aad u adeegsato faylka furaha ama aqoonsiyada asalka ah.
gcs-permissions-note: Sii akoonka adeegga WeKan awood akhris/qoris oo baaldiga ah: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → baaldigaaga → Permissions → Grant access. Gudaha "New principals", ku dheji iimaylka akoonka adeegga—qiimaha "client_email" ee furahaaga JSON—kadib dooro doorka "Storage Object Admin" oo Kaydi.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Bannaan uga tag si aad qiimaha hadda u hayso.
azure-container-description: Weelka blob ee faylasha lagu kaydinayo.
gcs-bucket-description: Magaca baaldiga Cloud Storage ee faylasha lagu kaydinayo.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: bannaan uga tag (wuxuu adeegsadaa barta dhammaadka gobolka). Kuwa S3 la jaanqaada: Endpoint URL-ka ka socda qalabkaaga MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → baaldigaaga → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → magaca baaldigaaga (ama Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → isticmaalahaaga → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → dooro xaaladda adeegsiga 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Waxaa loo muujiyaa 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Isla shaashadda Access key ID; 'Secret access key' waxaa la muujiyaa hal mar oo keliya marka furaha la abuuro—markaas koobiyee (ama Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akoonkaaga → magaca kore lagu muujiyey (sidoo kale hoosta Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akoonkaaga → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akoonkaaga → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akoonkaaga → Data storage → Containers → weelkaaga (ama + Container si aad mid u abuurto).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → xulaha mashruuca ee kore → ID-ga mashruucaaga (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → magaca baaldigaaga (ama Create si aad mid u samayso).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Jidka adeegaha WeKan ee faylka furaha JSON ee akoonka adeegga la soo dejiyey (hoos laga abuuray). Adeegso kan AMA JSON-ka ku dheji goobta hoose.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → akoonkaaga adeegga → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (wuxuu soo dejiyaa faylka). Nuxurkiisa halkan ku dheji, ama kaydi faylka oo jidkiisa kor ku deji.
cloud-secret-set: (waa la kaydiyey—bannaan uga tag si aad u hayso)
attachment-move-storage-azure: Lifaaqa u dhaqaaji Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Lifaaqa u dhaqaaji Google Cloud Storage

comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Wuxuu sameeyaa hubinno iyo hagaajinno dhamaystiran oo daacadnimada xogta sabuuradda ah, oo ay ku jiraan kala-horraynta liisaska, boosaska kaararka iyo qaab-dhismeedka waddooyinka.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration: Tirtir Liisaska Madhan ee Nuqulka ah
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Si ammaan ah ayuu u tirtiraa liisaska madhan ee nuqulka ah. Wuxuu saaraa keliya liisaska aan lahayn kaarar OO leh liis kale oo isla cinwaankaas ah oo kaarar ku jiraan.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Wuxuu helaa oo soo celiyaa kaararka iyo liisaska ay ka maqan yihiin swimlaneId ama listId. Wuxuu abuuraa waddo 'Kaararka Lumay' ah si dhammaan walxaha lumay mar kale u muuqdaan.
restore-all-archived-migration: Soo Celi Dhammaan Kuwa La Kaydiyey
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Wuxuu soo celiyaa dhammaan waddooyinka, liisaska iyo kaararka la kaydiyey. Si otomaatig ah ayuu u hagaajiyaa swimlaneId ama listId kasta oo maqan si walxuhu u muuqdaan.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Wuxuu ogaadaa oo hagaajiyaa liisaska maqan ama dhaawacmay ee qaab-dhismeedka sabuuradda.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Wuxuu cusboonaysiiyaa URL-yada sawirrada astaanta ee xubnaha sabuuradda si ay u adeegsadaan kaydka dambe ee saxda ah, wuxuuna hagaajiyaa tixraacyada sawirrada astaanta ee jaban.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Wuxuu cusboonaysiiyaa dhammaan URL-yada lifaaqyada faylasha ee sabuuraddan si ay u adeegsadaan kaydka dambe ee saxda ah, wuxuuna hagaajiyaa tixraacyada faylasha ee jaban.
migration-successful: Guuritaanku si guul leh ayuu u dhammaaday
migrations-admin-only: Keliya maamulayaasha sabuuradda ayaa socodsiin kara guuritaannada
migrations-description: Socodsii hubinta iyo hagaajinta daacadnimada xogta sabuuraddan. Guuritaan kasta si gaar ah ayaa loo fulin karaa.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Tani waxay samayn doontaa guuritaan dhamaystiran si loo hubiyo loona hagaajiyo daacadnimada xogta sabuuradda. Waxay qaadan kartaa dhowr daqiiqadood. Ma sii waddaa?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Tani waxay marka hore liisaska la wadaago u beddeli doontaa liisas waddo kasta gaar u ah, kadibna waxay tirtiri doontaa liisaska madhan ee leh liis nuqul ah oo isla cinwaan leh kaararna ku jiraan. Keliya liisaska madhan ee dhab ahaan dheeraadka ah ayaa la saari doonaa. Ma sii waddaa?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Tani waxay abuuri doontaa waddo 'Kaararka Lumay' ah, waxayna soo celin doontaa dhammaan kaararka iyo liisaska ay ka maqan yihiin swimlaneId ama listId. Tani waxay saamaynaysaa keliya walxaha aan la kaydin. Ma sii waddaa?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Tani waxay soo celin doontaa DHAMMAAN waddooyinka, liisaska iyo kaararka la kaydiyey, iyadoo mar kale ka dhigaysa kuwo muuqda. Walax kasta oo aqoonsigeedu maqan yahay si otomaatig ah ayaa loo hagaajin doonaa. Tan si fudud dib looguma celin karo. Ma sii waddaa?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Tani waxay ogaan doontaa oo hagaajin doontaa liisaska maqan ama dhaawacmay ee qaab-dhismeedka sabuuradda. Ma sii waddaa?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Tani waxay cusboonaysiin doontaa URL-yada sawirrada astaanta ee xubnaha sabuuradda si ay u adeegsadaan kaydka dambe ee saxda ah. Ma sii waddaa?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Tani waxay cusboonaysiin doontaa dhammaan URL-yada lifaaqyada faylasha ee sabuuraddan si ay u adeegsadaan kaydka dambe ee saxda ah. Ma sii waddaa?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Ma jiraan waddooyin, liisas ama kaarar lumay oo la soo celiyo
migration-progress-note: Fadlan sug inta aan sabuuraddaada u guurinayno qaab-dhismeedka ugu dambeeya...

converting-board-description: Qaab-dhismeedka sabuuradda ayaa loo beddelayaa awood shaqo oo hagaagsan. Tani waxay qaadan kartaa dhowr daqiiqadood.
migration-batch-size-description: Tirada lifaaqyada laga shaqaynayo dufcad kasta (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Hakad geli guuritaanka marka adeegsiga CPU uu ka bato boqolleydan (10-90)
migration-delay-ms-description: Dib-u-dhaca u dhexeeya dufcadaha oo millisekan ah (100-10000)

migration-warning-text: Fadlan ha xirin biraawsarkaaga inta guuritaanku socdo. Hawshu gadaasha ayay ka sii socon doontaa, laakiin waxay qaadan kartaa waqti dheer inay dhammaato.

problems-in-progress-help: Guuritaannadan ama hagaajintani hadda way socdaan. Gelitaannadu way gaabis noqon karaan, ama waxay muujin karaan "Waa inaad gashaa" ama wareege "Waa la soo rarayaa, fadlan sug", ilaa ay dhammaadaan oo CPU-gu hoos u dhaco.
